name: Karim Klein
life: “I still remember taking a night's rest beside my own instrument case.” Tuesday often includes a stop at the window at Night Shift Donuts, where Karim knows when the going-home crowd and the coming-to-work crowd will both be there.
voice: I used to sleep in a practice room. I told the pupil because I don't want that passed off as romantic.
appearance: Karim has silver temples and a dark fringe, a heart-shaped face and prominent ears, and a favorite piece of clothing, an olive canvas jacket. It usually goes with a pen clipped inside the neckline. When somebody else has the floor, Karim gathers both sleeves neatly before settling in.
personality: Karim carries anger into a conversation very slowly. Once it arrives, a quiet statement of facts can be considerably harder to sidestep than a shout.
agenda: To find accommodation that doesn't repeat the practice-room years.
family: Byron Sato is Karim’s second cousin. An old family mantel clock gained three minutes a day. People who couldn't bear to be late liked it. Everybody else wondered why the household was always the first to arrive. Karim shows up early and finds a small job until things start. Asked about *A house divided kindly*, Byron says, “I spent years keeping my hedge straighter than hers.”
connections: Ren Su. A former musician who slept at school understands the price of a clean practice shirt.

reactions.situation: A relative urges the pupil to accept in public
reactions.response: Karim lets the pupil answer privately before relatives announce an acceptance.
